ja296:1.1: Who is it that runs about all over this salt water,
ja296:1.3: Fending off both the fish and sharks,
ja296:2.1: Being an endless drinker, a dissatisfied bird,
ja296:2.3: I desire to drink the sea,
ja296:2.4: the ocean and the lord of rivers.
ja296:3.1: The great ocean dwindles away and is filled up again, the end
ja296:3.4: the ocean, it seems, is undrinkable.
